title: Toxic Efflux
description: The environment outside is already saturated with waste. A passive waste channel will let it flood in, not out — you need an active pump.

narrative.intro: This patch of tissue is already toxic: waste concentration outside is higher than anything your cell will produce internally. A plain diffusion channel here works against you — waste flows downhill, and downhill is into the cell. You need something that moves waste out regardless of the gradient.
narrative.outro: Real cells solve this with ATP-powered efflux pumps — the same family of transporters behind multidrug resistance in cancer cells and antibiotic resistance in bacteria. Moving something against its gradient always costs energy; that trade-off just showed up in your ATP budget.

goals.description: Keep internal waste at or below 6.
Keep cytoplasmic ATP at or above 2 for 10 straight ticks.

failConditions.description: Internal waste hit toxic levels — the cell is dead.
